run_index.description: One row per distinct frozen trajectory. Raw paths are relative to the project root.

block_metrics.description: All scalar frozen metrics plus explicitly labelled equivalent label-flip onset/active-window arithmetic. One measurement per block.

means_all_metrics.description: All measured method/regime/scenario/metric cells. Five block values, sample SD, range and nominal 95% t interval.

paired_effects.description: Candidate minus comparator in shared measured scenarios. Five matched block/seed differences. No pooling across regimes.

accuracy_curves.description: Saved legitimate-task accuracy (%) by round, method, scenario, cohort and block.

onset_by_block.description: Label-flip round-5 accuracy and own-clean damage, raw onset change and later fragility. All 14 methods.

core_results.description: Main 11-method table. Explicit not_tested cells with NA numbers. Means and five-block uncertainty.

core_IID.description: Compact mean table; precision retained. Use core_results for SD, CI and each block.

core_non_IID.description: Compact mean table; precision retained. Use core_results for SD, CI and each block.

coverage.description: Full method × regime × scenario coverage. Zero here means no runs, never zero performance.

descriptive_best_baseline.description: Best mean among baselines actually measured for each cell. Post hoc description, not a significance claim or altered success criterion.

training_loss_by_block.description: Online local cross-entropy on the batches used during SGD. May use poisoned labels. No training-accuracy metric was recorded. Group names denote client IDs, not inferred intent.

training_loss_summary.description: Five-block summaries of online training loss, separate from held-out legitimate-task accuracy.

evaluation_tasks_by_block.description: Fixed balanced development tasks, 1000 images/task. These unweighted task scores differ from population-weighted legitimate-task scores in the main comparison.

evaluation_tasks_accuracy_percent_summar.description: Five-block fixed-task summaries. Do not substitute for affected-cohort or population-weighted main outcomes.

evaluation_tasks_cross_entropy_summary.description: Five-block fixed-task summaries. Do not substitute for affected-cohort or population-weighted main outcomes.

per_class_evaluation_by_block.description: Per-digit development task accuracy and cross-entropy over rounds 5–24. All 880 trajectories retained.

run_settings.description: Exact saved per-run algorithm settings and pairing identifiers. JSON fields preserve algorithm-specific parameters.

data_access_by_run.description: Verified saved constructor/reference access for every run. Evaluator data and official test are not aggregation inputs.

methods_and_access.description: Method names, reference-data requirements and reproduction scope.

costs_by_run.description: All timing/resource measurements. Concurrent wall time and process RSS are descriptive; RSS includes interpreter, data and framework.

costs_by_scenario.description: Five-block costs kept per scenario to avoid unequal-coverage pooling.

costs_common_three_scenarios.description: Each block averages the same three scenarios: clean, stripes and label flip. No causal speed ranking across different study dates.
